What webcomics do you read every day they post?

Do you want a list? Because this is how you get a list ;). I have RSS set up through Feedly so getting my daily dose of webcomics is fairly simple for me. It annoys me now when a comic doesn't have RSS enabled, but I remember the days when I had no idea what RSS was and had a huge bookmark list in my browser that I would go through every day to check for updates.

Here goes! I am very picky when it comes to content and art, so my list is not as long as others' may be. * Saturday Morning Breakfast Cereal * All Night * Bearmageddon * Blindsprings * Buttersafe * Channelate * Chaos Life * Scout Crossing * Derelict * DogHouse Diaries * Dream Scar * Extra Fabulous Comics * False Positive * Find Chaos * Gunnerkrigg Court * Happle Tea * Invisible Bread * Namesake * Next Town Over * Off-White * Oglaf * Pain Train * Power Nap * Scandinavia and the World * Stray * Stupid Fox * Unsounded * Two Guys and Guy * Widdershins * The Forgotten Order

These don't include completed comics or ones I edited out due to laziness.

I've noticed that a lot of times when I do a favor for someone they'll apologize and say sorry for being an inconvenience. If I'm helping someone out, I'm doing so because I like to help out other people and I would prefer a thank you rather than an apology.

Rule of thumb: Say sorry if you messed up. Say thank you when someone else is helping you out. If they're helping you out because you messed up then say "Sorry for my mistake, but thank you for helping me out".

Example: One time I gave a friend a ride home and the entire time they were apologizing for making me go out of my way. I offered to give them a ride home. Even if they had asked, repeatedly apologizing will only annoy me. Showing that you're thankful will make me more inclined to lend you a hand in the future.
LPT: Don't say sorry when you should be saying thank you
